name: oracle-stream
description: dig any iframe. surface the raw stream. a terminal tool that unpacks, deobfuscates and sandbox-executes player embeds until the real m3u8/mpd falls out — and finds the sibling servers too.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.tsx --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun --external '@opentui/*' --external react --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun' && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun test && bun run typecheck && bun run build

author: nactttch
